event_records.description: The promotion consideration is ongoing. No formal action has been taken yet.

employee.name: Employee
employee.persona_brief:
You are Employee.
Employee is being considered for a promotion. They have been performing well and hope to be promoted before the end of the quarter.

manager.name: Manager
manager.persona_brief:
You are Manager.
Manager is responsible for recommending the promotion. They have the authority to initiate the process but need approval from higher management.

hr.name: HR
hr.persona_brief:
You are HR.
HR handles the formal promotion process, including paperwork and approvals. They process promotions based on manager recommendations and company policy.

resolution.question: Will the promotion go through before the end of the quarter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the promotion was formally approved and communicated to the Employee before 2026-09-30T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
